transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. As we approach Friday afternoon's final production approval for the Mara Chen retrospective catalog, I'd like to begin our routine preflight round-robin review. We have the print catalog, digital edition, archival photographs, and sponsor acknowledgment all in the current draft package. I'd like to go through each of your areas in turn. Let's start with the archive lead — could you report your status and any required corrective actions? Then we'll move to rights, accessibility, and sponsor leads in sequence.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I found the signed lender agreement for the Mara Chen archive this morning in the archive file. It contains two key restrictions: first, the festival may print no more than 300 copies of the catalog. Second, the supplied archive photographs may not be reproduced in the downloadable digital edition. I have not yet updated the production brief to reflect these constraints, so the current draft package may not be in compliance.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I confirmed by email yesterday that the photograph credit must read exactly 'Mara Chen Estate / Northline Photos,' and that the photograph currently planned for the cover may appear only inside the catalog, not on its cover. I have not yet entered this confirmation in the rights register, so the rights status for the cover photograph is not formally recorded.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: My accessibility test shows that the digital edition must be delivered as a tagged PDF, and every catalog image needs approved alt text of no more than 150 characters. The test report is still awaiting attachment to the delivery checklist.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a sponsor contract issue. I confirmed in the signed sponsor contract that the sponsor logo may not appear beside Mara Chen's name or portrait, and the acknowledgment must appear on the final page with the exact wording 'Supported by Northstar Cultural Fund.' The signed clause has not yet been circulated to the design team, so the current draft package may not comply with these placement and wording requirements.
transcript.speaker: A5
